newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-KELLY, BOWYER PILE ON WEST HAM MISERY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KELLY, BOWYER PILE ON WEST HAM MISERY.

text.p: Rare strikes from Gary Kelly and Lee Bowyer gave George Graham only his second away premier league win as Leeds manager as they beat West Ham 2-0 on Monday.
Defeat left West Ham third from the bottom and supporters calling for the head of manager Harry Redknapp.
Once West Ham went 1-0 down through Kelly's goal from a free-kick in the 53rd minute Upton Park fans began a chorus of "Redknapp out".
Ireland defender Kelly had found the target only once before for Leeds but he broke the stalemate with a 28-yard shot that went in off the bar and goalkeeper Ludek Miklosko's back.
There was even less Miklosko could do 21 minutes from time when England under-21 international Bowyer took his time before firing into the far corner for just his third goal since joining Leeds.
